Analizar variaciones entre resultados reales y presupuestados, identificando causas y acciones correctivas. Identificar oportunidades de automatización y reducción de procesos manuales. Fortalecer la calidad de la información, los reportes y los controles entre las áreas operativas y administrativas. Experiencia indispensable en empresas de retail con varias sucursales y manejo significativo de inventarios. Conocimiento sólido de NIF, legislación fiscal mexicana y elaboración de estados financieros. Experiencia en conciliación de ventas, bancos, inventarios y operaciones de e-commerce. Dominio de ERP; altamente deseable experiencia con Intelisis. Excel avanzado y capacidad para analizar y presentar información financiera. review_candidates.title: Chile Country Director
review_candidates.description: Location : Santiago, Chile What We Can Achieve Together The Nature Conservancy (TNC) seeks a strategic, entrepreneurial, and values-driven leader to serve as Chile Country Director. The Director will lead TNC’s presence in Chile, ensuring accountability for the strategy performance, wellbeing, reputation, and sustainability. They are responsible for delivering measurable conservation impact, mobilizing partnerships and financial resources, leading with example excellence standards. The ideal candidate combines strategic vision with strong execution, high emotional intelligence, sound judgment, political acumen, and the ability to lead through others. They will bring a deep understanding of Chile’s environmental, social, economic, and institutional context and use that perspective to position TNC as a trusted partner to government, communities, Indigenous Peoples, donors, businesses, academia, and civil society. The Director will be expected to navigate complex and sometimes competing stakeholder interests, exercise sound judgment in high-stakes situations, and represent TNC credibly with senior government, business, philanthropic, and civil society leaders. Internally, they will align TNC decisions and priorities, fully owning these and representing them to staff in the appropriate way. As part of TNC’s Latin America leadership, the Director will connect Chile’s priorities with regional and global strategies, identifying opportunities to collaborate across geographies and scale successful approaches. They will ensure that conservation ambition is matched by the partnerships, funding, talent, governance, and operational capacity required for delivery. The Director will lead a multidisciplinary team of approximately 30 staff and work with more than 25 partners. As the senior leader for TNC in Chile, the Director is accountable for creating the conditions for the team to succeed, with our Code of conduct in mind and actions, building leadership capacity across the organization, and ensuring resources are focused on the areas of greatest conservation and organizational impact. They will also play a significant role in fundraising, donor cultivation, financial stewardship, talent development, external representation, and organizational culture. The position reports to the Director of Program Implementation & Alignment, Latin America. Responsibilities & Scope Provide overall leadership for TNC Chile, translating regional and global priorities into a clear country agenda with measurable conservation, organizational, and financial outcomes while holding ultimate accountability for the performance and sustainability of the country program, Ensure strong financial and operational control, aligning budgets, staffing, fundraising, and organizational capacity with priority outcomes and long-term financial sustainability. Lead, develop, and empower a high-performing multidisciplinary team, setting clear priorities and expectations while strengthening accountability, collaboration, career development, and succession. Manage organizational, fiduciary, legal, operational, and reputational risks proactively, ensuring timely escalation and sound decision-making. Acts as the senior accountable representative of TNC Chile, ensuring compliance with all applicable Chilean legal, regulatory, labor, tax, governance, and reporting requirements. Position TNC as a trusted and influential partner in Chile’s conservation and sustainable development agenda, working with government, communities, Indigenous Peoples, the private sector, foundations, academia, and civil society. Mobilize resources at the highest level, partnering closely with Regional and Global Development teams to identify, cultivate, and steward public, private, philanthropic, and institutional donors both for Latin American and for Chile. Advance systems-level conservation solutions by helping shape policy, mobilize resources, build partnerships, and scale approaches with relevance beyond individual projects. Contribute actively to LAR leadership, connecting Chile’s priorities and capabilities with regional strategies, Iconic Places, and enterprise opportunities. Develop and empower leaders within the Chile program, delegating decision-making appropriately managing conflicts in a timely manner, and building leadership capacity and succession within their team. Build a culture of trust, inclusion, respect, and shared accountability, consistently modeling TNC’s values and expected leadership behaviors. Work across TNC to access and leverage regional and global expertise, creating synergies and ensuring Chile benefits from the full capabilities of the organization. What You’ll Bring 7 years of relevant professional experience, including at least 5 years in equivalent leadership roles in conservation, sustainability/ESG, nonprofit leadership, advocacy, business, government, or related fields. Recognized leadership credibility and a strong professional reputation in Chile’s conservation, sustainability, public policy, finance, business, academic, or philanthropic sectors. Fluency in Spanish and English, with strong written, verbal, and executive communication skills. Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, set priorities, delegate effectively, manage performance, and develop talent. A successful record of leading complex, high-profile initiatives and translating strategy into measurable results, preferably influencing private and public sector agendas. Demonstrated ability to balance conservation ambition with financial sustainability, organizational capacity, and implementation realities. Demonstrated fundraising and resource-mobilization experience across public, private, corporate, foundation, or philanthropic sources. Strong financial management experience, including budgeting, forecasting, resource allocation, and stewardship. Proven success building trusted relationships with government, donors, boards, communities, businesses, NGOs, and other strategic partners. Strong understanding of Chile’s environmental, political, institutional, and socioeconomic context. Demonstrated ability to navigate complexity, ambiguity, organizational change, and sensitive stakeholder environments with judgment and discretion. Desired Qualifications Knowledge and experience also outside of Chile, at regional level in South America or Latin America. Political and cultural fluency, with the ability to influence without relying solely on formal authority. Experience negotiating complex agreements and building coalitions across sectors. Strong donor-facing, presentation, and external representation skills. Experience leading organizations or programs through significant change or transition. Successful experience mobilizing and/or managing significant resources, ideally including portfolios of $6M+ annually. Ability to build strong teams and develop future leaders through coaching, feedback, stretch opportunities, and clear accountability. Job Family: General Management Pay Grade: 9 Job Code: 150024MP Who We Are The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor. One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.” What We Bring Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world! TNC offers competitive and comprehensive benefits packages tailored to the individual countries where we work. These may include health care benefits, retirement benefits, parental leave, paid time off, life insurance, and disability coverage as well as an employee assistance program and other life and well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here. We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports the health and well-being of the people we employ. Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible. Employees must submit their application by logging into Workday and applying via the Jobs Hub. The Nature Conservancy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization is a priority, and we encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military, protected veteran status or other status protected by law. The successful applicant must meet the requirements of The Nature Conservancy's background screening process. TNC is committed to offering accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please send a note to applyhelp@tnc.org with Request for Accommodation in the subject line.

review_candidates.description: Centralized monitoring is an integral part of a risk-based monitoring strategy, defined as the timely, remote review of accumulating subject and operational data to help distinguish between reliable and unreliable data, trends, outliers, and unusual variability using analytics and statistical methods. The central monitor is responsible for conducting a holistic and centralized statistical review of study data from study start through to study database lock according to the centralized monitoring plan, using analytical tools to identify emerging and existing risks to critical study data and process. The central monitor enables proactive identification, communication, escalation and management of risks at the study/country/site level. Responsibilities Follow established procedures for the review of clinical trial data (Operational and Subject data) using a variety of tools and systems in alignment with the centralized monitoring plan and with support from the senior team members. Identify data quality trends indicative of systematic errors and potential performance issues at study/country/site and track the evidence of issues and potential risks with support from senior team members. Ensure results of reviews are appropriately documented per procedures. Support Central Monitoring teams with performance of assigned reviews with high quality, on-time results. Provide input to senior team member as needed to support development of risk characterization and reporting. Support review set-up as directed by assigned lead including updating department database, pulling reports, etc. as assigned. Share the responsibility for data quality at the study, country and site levels. Requirements: Education Bachelor’s degree in a field relevant to clinical research. Experience Minimum of 1 year of experience in central statistical monitoring with overall 6 years of experience in two or more operational areas such as clinical monitoring, data management, drug safety, medical monitoring, biometrics, or project management. Basic understanding of statistical monitoring and Risk Based Quality Management (RBQM) and their impact on data integrity. Thorough understanding of the processes associated with clinical study management, data management, and regulatory operations. Knowledge of clinical trial database systems (EDC, IRT, CTMS, etc.). Good computer skills, with knowledge of advanced MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and the ability to learn and use interactive computer systems and tools. Ideally a basic level of understanding of descriptive analysis e.g. means, medians, significance, confidence intervals. Must have been involved in the analysis and review of clinical data, ability to extract pertinent information from standard study documentation, such as protocols, electronic study data systems with the ability to learn to identify trending of site/study data. Must be able to work in non-traditional work environments. Attributes Fluent in English (excellent oral and written). Must be able to communicate clearly and effectively at all levels in an organization and with external customers. Must be a fast learner and able to understand new concepts quickly. Prioritization skills with ability to plan, monitor and manage workload fluidly in response to changing project demands. Satisfactory understanding of project protocol, project documentation including centralized monitoring and risk-based monitoring. Broad working knowledge of the roles, functions and process of conducting clinical trials. Must be able to manage time effectively, working with multiple functions and requirements. Must have been involved in the use of trial management or data management systems. Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines. Our company: The work environment At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities. In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks: Flexible work schedule Permanent full-time position Ongoing learning and development Work location Note that this opening is for a home-based position in Philippines. Attendance at some meetings outside of regular business hours (primarily in the evening) is required. About Indero A Global Clinical Leader In Dermatology and Rheumatology! Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint. Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale. Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request. Indero only accepts applicants who can legally work in Poland.

review_candidates.title: Analista de Desembaraço Aduaneiro (Exportação)
review_candidates.description: Na GP Cargo, somos especialistas em desembaraço aduaneiro, atuando com precisão e agilidade na liberação de cargas junto à Receita Federal e demais órgãos anuentes, garantindo conformidade legal e eficiência nos processos de importação e exportação. Somos movidos por desafios e acreditamos na inovação como caminho para transformar processos. Por isso, buscamos constantemente soluções inteligentes e completas, oferecendo um serviço porta a porta que simplifica e dá transparência às operações de comércio exterior. Desde 2015, somos certificados pela ISO 9001, reforçando nosso compromisso com a qualidade. E desde 2017, temos o orgulho de ser reconhecidos como uma excelente empresa para se trabalhar, por meio do selo GPTW (Great Place to Work). Além disso, fomos um dos primeiros agentes de carga do Brasil a conquistar o título de Operador Econômico Autorizado (OEA) pela Receita Federal, o que reforça nossa credibilidade e excelência no setor. Buscamos alguém para compor nosso time atuando com: Elaborar, emitir, analisar e conferir documentos de exportação, incluindo Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Nota fiscal, Declaração Única de Exportação (DU-E), Certificados de Origem (CO), certificados de livre venda, declarações complementares, drafts de documentos de transporte e demais documentos exigidos conforme a natureza da mercadoria, o país de destino e as particularidades da operação; Solicitar, emitir e acompanhar Certificados de Origem (CO), por meio das plataformas da FIEMG, Fecomércio e demais entidades habilitadas, verificando os requisitos de origem, acordos comerciais aplicáveis e a conformidade das informações documentais; Operar e acompanhar processos nos sistemas Portal Único, plataformas de entidades certificadoras e demais sistemas governamentais e operacionais utilizados nas operações de exportação; Realizar registros, retificações e acompanhamento de DU-E e LPCO, quando aplicáveis, assegurando a conformidade das informações e o atendimento às exigências legais e administrativas; Analisar descritivos de mercadorias, classificações fiscais (NCM), tratamento administrativo e requisitos específicos de exportação, identificando a necessidade de licenças, autorizações, certificados e demais documentos exigidos pelos órgãos competentes; Controlar prazos operacionais e documentais dos processos de exportação, com especial atenção aos deadlines de booking, evitando atrasos, armazenagens e possíveis penalidades; Controlar prazos, etapas e procedimentos dos processos de exportação, desde a abertura até a conclusão do despacho aduaneiro, acompanhando a liberação, o embarque e a averbação da DU-E, garantindo o cumprimento das exigências legais e operacionais; Manter contato com agentes de carga, terminais, transportadoras, recintos alfandegados, despachantes e órgãos anuentes, alinhando programações de carregamento, entrega de cargas, embarques, liberações e demais procedimentos operacionais; Acompanhar operações vinculadas a regimes aduaneiros especiais, como Drawback, Exportação Temporária e Reexportação de mercadorias admitidas temporariamente, observando os requisitos documentais, os prazos, os controles e os procedimentos específicos de cada modalidade; Realizar follow-up com clientes, fornecedores e parceiros logísticos, prestando informações sobre o andamento dos processos, esclarecendo dúvidas, antecipando possíveis impactos e orientando quanto às providências necessárias para a continuidade das operações; Atualizar planilhas de controle interno, alimentar os sistemas operacionais e manter os registros dos processos atualizados, assegurando a rastreabilidade das informações e a confiabilidade dos dados; Organizar, conferir e arquivar documentos físicos e digitais dos processos de exportação, garantindo a integridade, a disponibilidade e a rastreabilidade documental; Identificar e reportar inconsistências documentais, divergências operacionais e exigências aduaneiras, atuando de forma proativa na resolução de pendências junto aos clientes, parceiros, Receita Federal e demais órgãos competentes; Prestar suporte técnico à equipe em operações de maior complexidade, compartilhando conhecimentos sobre legislação aduaneira, procedimentos de exportação, documentação e boas práticas operacionais, contribuindo para a padronização e a melhoria contínua dos processos. review_candidates.title: Amazon Brand Manager
review_candidates.description: Role: Amazon Brand Manager Schedule: 9:00am - 5:00pm EST, Monday to Friday Remote: Eastern Europe The Amazon Brand Manager owns one or more brands on Amazon end to end, from the listing to the reorder, and is accountable for growing them profitably. Unlike a specialist who handles one piece (PPC, listings or account health), this person runs the whole account: advertising, catalog, pricing, inventory, brand protection and launches. The core of the job is growing sales while improving advertising efficiency, typically measured through TACoS and contribution margin. Success is not cutting spend and letting sales fall with it; it is restructuring campaigns, harvesting search terms and improving conversion so revenue grows while ad spend shrinks as a share of sales. The role works with a high degree of autonomy. The Brand Manager reports to a brand owner or client lead and is expected to bring the agenda: what is working, what is not, and what they want to change next. Responsibilities The scope of work would include: PPC across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display: campaign structure, bids, placements and search term harvesting Listings: titles, bullets, A+ content, images, keywords and catalog accuracy Pricing, coupons, deals and promotions Inventory: tracking sell-through and flagging reorders early enough that the brand never stocks out Brand health: suppressed listings, policy issues, hijackers and unauthorized sellers New product launches A weekly report on sales, ad spend, TACoS, inventory and what you're changing next Requirements Running at least one brand's Amazon account end to end - not just one piece of it, and being able to present the scaling metrics Independent building and managing PPC campaigns 2+ years managing Amazon accounts in Seller Central, with at least one brand run end to end (not only PPC or only listings) Measurable results from that account: candidates must share before-and-after numbers such as revenue, TACoS, ACoS or organic rank Hands-on PPC experience building and managing Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display campaigns personally Proven experience improving ad efficiency while growing or holding sales, and the ability to explain how it was done Working knowledge of listing optimization, Brand Registry, A+ Content and catalog troubleshooting Comfort with inventory planning: sell-through, days of cover, FBA restock limits and reorder timing Strong written English, able to write a clear weekly report and recommend changes without being asked Self-directed: works without a daily checklist and owns outcomes You know the difference between cutting spend and fixing efficiency, and you've done the second one Strong written English Nice To Have: Experience with Amazon category of supplements Building an Amazon brand from scratch Benefits Remote Work: Work from anywhere—our team is global, and we value work-life balance. Growth Opportunities: As a key player i you'll have the chance to shape your role and grow with us. Innovative Culture: Join a team that is passionate about leveraging data to solve challenges and drive success in a rapidly evolving market As part of our recruitment process, all candidates will be kindly asked to agree to Lago's Confidentiality and Non-Circumvention Agreement . This ensures a respectful and professional experience for everyone involved.
